★Request
Motion as if casting a spell
She didn't do her homework, so when I tried to have her do supplementary work instead, she fled...

It is NOT impossible!
You're my familiar, so obey your master's orders!

One day, when I stopped by the library,
I found Sweep Tosho engrossed in some research.

Found it! This is totally the one.
I thought I'd seen it before!

Fine then, I know I can finish my homework in a flash with magic.
I'll never let her tell me to stay after class again!
Balancing your studies and training is essential if you wish to continue as an athlete in the future. The homework is assigned as practice for that, you know.

Mmm... well, fine. That sounds fun too!
Here goes nothing—

Heheh, naturally! Now I can leave Teacher speechless!
I'm gonna blow her away right now!

What gives?! Even my familiar is nagging me about homework, homework!
Didn't you chase Teacher away for me?!
Then you do it, familiar!!
Sweep Tosho-san!

As if truly under a magic spell,
Sweep Tosho blazed through her homework with brisk efficiency.

Well, duh!
There's NO WAY I'm staying after class! No, no, NO!!

Eeeek! Why?!
I cast a binding spell on you and everything!

Sweep Tosho threw a tantrum as she spoke.
Her complete disregard for things that didn't interest her was honest in a way, but...

Huh, isn't that kinda roundabout?
It's a speed-up spell... right?
“In an instant, be written! Alstroemeria☆”

Be quiet! Don't boss me around!
If I don't wanna do it, I'm not gonna do it!

Whenever she tackled something of her own accord,
she truly radiated brilliant brilliance.

This question is... Uh-oh, I'm losing speed!
“Solve as if at a gallop, Alstroemeria☆”

As their voices grew louder, critical glances turned toward them from all around.
I had to calm them both down before things got out of hand.

More importantly, why didn't my magic work?!
I did it exactly like the book said, too~!
Magic on me? What's that supposed to mean?

Huh? ...You mean fill in the answers with magic?
Hmm, sounds fun.

Sweep Tosho's eyes sparkled with life as she spoke.
It was a moment that drove home just how hard she could work when it was something she enjoyed.

Your Trainer looked after you, didn't they?
Be sure to thank them properly later!
“Thorns☆ Thorns☆ Entwine!!”
I found myself recalling how she acted whenever something piqued her interest.

Ah, Trainer-san, you were with her too.
The truth is, Sweep Tosho-san—
Never mind that, hurry up or she'll catch up to us!

Listen closely, Sweep Tosho-san.
I'm not just asking you to do homework for the sake of it.
Sweep Tosho-san, there you are!

Ugh, SERIOUSLY?!
Why aren't you amazed by my magic instead of talking about my familiar?!
—Every single one is correct. Honestly, you can do it when you try, so stop running away at every turn. And furthermore—

All right, let's start with question one...
Hey, this is a piece of cake!
Hey, why are you keeping quiet...?

Found it! This is totally the one.
I thought I'd seen it before!

Amazing, I finished in no time at all!
Behold, familiar! That's the power of the magical girl Sweepy!
We moved to the trainer's office, where I suggested once again that we finish up her homework, but—
Hmph! Of course I'm great, that's a given!
